letter_text: The top tier price is not proportional to the cost of service for my parcel.
Charging hydrant costs to residential meters violates Proposition 218.
I protest. Rates are too high for people on fixed incomes.
The peaking factors in the study are not supported by any data.
This is illegal and I protest.
Tier 3 subsidizes the recycled water program, which I do not receive.
The methodology shifts commercial costs to homes. Article XIII D forbids that.
